title.zh: 去胶清洗：去掉目标物，也要保护底层
title.en: Stripping and cleaning: remove targets while protecting underlayers

subtitle.zh: 分清大量去胶、薄残胶清除与刻后残留处理
subtitle.en: Distinguish bulk stripping, descum, and post-etch residue removal

body.zh: 灰化/去胶去除主体有机胶层，将有机物转为挥发性产物并排出。Descum 仅清除显影后开口底部的薄残胶，保留光刻胶图形。图中下层为目标层和衬底。
body.en: Ashing/stripping removes bulk organic resist by converting it to volatile products and exhausting them. Descum removes only thin residual resist at developed opening bottoms while retaining the resist pattern. Underlayers are target and substrate.

body.zh: 氧活性物种使有机组分转化为可排出的挥发性产物。流程：辨认胶与底层 → 选择化学体系 → 控制温度与暴露 → 必要后清洗 → 检查残留与膜损失。控制化学体系、温度、处理时间、离子暴露。
body.en: Reactive oxygen converts organic material into exhaustible volatile products. Flow: identify resist/underlayer → choose chemistry → control temperature/exposure → post-clean if needed → inspect residue/film loss. Control chemistry, temperature, treatment time, and ion exposure.

body.zh: 风险：金属氧化、底层材料损失、含碳低 k 介质损伤。刻后残留可能含有机物、无机物或金属组分，需要选择干法、湿法或组合路线。
body.en: Risks: metal oxidation, underlayer loss, damage to carbon-containing low-k dielectrics. Post-etch residue can include organics, inorganics, or metals, requiring dry, wet, or combined removal.

body.zh: 以表面形貌看残留缺陷、表面成分辨认残留类型、膜厚变化评估底层膜损失。异常先复核残留类型与材料相容性。要同时满足残留去除与材料保护，为后续接触和成膜提供合适表面。
body.en: Use surface morphology to inspect residue defects, composition to identify residue type, and thickness change to assess underlayer loss. First recheck residue type and material compatibility when abnormal. Meet both residue removal and material-protection goals to prepare surfaces for contacts/deposition.

uncertain: 页末水印与实质文字或图示区域重叠；figureCrop保留完整图表，未猜测补画遮挡区域。
